# CDS3004 project — headline metrics (auto-generated by the notebook)

All numbers below are computed by `notebooks/CDS3004_Project.ipynb` and match `results/metrics.json`; no value is hand-entered.

- **Data**: 541,909 raw transaction lines → 391,150 clean lines (72.18% of rows, 81.91% of gross revenue); 4,334 identified customers, 2010-12-01..2011-12-09.
- **Guests dropped**: 135,080 lines have no CustomerID (24.93% of rows, 13.57% of gross revenue) — customer analytics cannot attribute them; this is a documented limitation, not a data loss.
- **Issue counts (audit)**: 5,268 duplicate rows, 9,288 cancellation lines, 10,624 negative-quantity lines, 2,517 non-positive prices, 2,916 non-product/service lines. A line can violate several rules, so the funnel actually removes fewer: 8,905 cancellations, 1,547 non-product lines and 5,187 duplicates (see t03_cleaning_decisions.csv).
- **Cohorts**: T1 (as of 2011-05-31, n=2,716) churn rate 0.5044; T2 out-of-time (as of 2011-08-31, n=2,809) churn rate 0.3955.
- **Similarity**: cosine distance wins — silhouette euclidean 0.1844, cosine 0.3283, manhattan 0.2183.
- **Feature selection**: 16 engineered features → 10 selected; validation PR-AUC 0.6966 (all) vs 0.7036 (selected).
- **Segmentation**: K=5, silhouette 0.3279, bootstrap stability ARI 0.9699; sizes Champions=755, Loyal=582, Potential=520, At-risk=535, Hibernating=417.
- **Churn models — T1 held-out test**: logreg AUC 0.7227, PR-AUC 0.6744, top-10% lift 1.35; decision_tree AUC 0.6827, PR-AUC 0.6325, top-10% lift 1.26; random_forest AUC 0.7216, PR-AUC 0.6684, top-10% lift 1.30
- **Churn models — T2 out-of-time**: logreg AUC 0.7392, PR-AUC 0.5947, top-10% lift 1.69; decision_tree AUC 0.7095, PR-AUC 0.5518, top-10% lift 1.61; random_forest AUC 0.7323, PR-AUC 0.5813, top-10% lift 1.58
- **Selected model**: logreg (chosen on validation PR-AUC 0.7079; never on test). F1-optimal threshold 0.267; top-10% capacity threshold 0.738. T2 top-10% precision 0.6690, recall 0.1692, lift 1.69.
- **Association rules**: 5,441 rules (support≥0.005, confidence≥0.2, lift≥1.2, max_len=3) from 3,792 frequent itemsets; 5,402 evaluated on the later holdout period. Headline replication: median holdout lift 12.17 (99.8% of rules keep lift>1, 99.4% keep lift>2); the mean training lift 128.46 and mean holdout lift 28.20 are inflated by rare product-variant pairs (support ~0.5%, median holdout support 0.588%).
- **Decision framework (base scenario)**: 200 priority targets (7.1% of T2, score = churn probability x monetary); save rate 10%, contact cost GBP 8.00, margin 35%; p_churn_targeted 0.669 -> 133.8 churners, 13.4 saves x GBP 2,646 per saved = gross GBP 35,400, cost GBP 1,600, net GBP 33,800 (ROI 2112%). Random-200 baseline: net GBP 1,926 (ROI 120%); net uplift GBP 31,874; break-even save rate 0.45% (targeted) vs 4.54% (random).
- **Business rules (support≥1%, lift≥2, one direction per pair)**: 593 rules; top 3 by frequency: `22697 -> 22699` (GREEN REGENCY TEACUP AND S -> ROSES REGENCY TEACUP AND S, lift 16.4, support 3.4%); `22386 -> 85099B` (JUMBO BAG PINK POLKADOT -> JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT, lift 7.5, support 3.0%); `22384 -> 20725` (LUNCH BAG PINK POLKADOT -> LUNCH BAG RED RETROSPOT, lift 7.3, support 3.0%).
- **Segment-level campaign** (all T2 customers, base scenario): net expected value GBP 14,362.23 on gross benefit GBP 36,834.23 and contact cost GBP 22,472.00.
- **Runtime**: 29.0 s on this machine (3.14.6, pandas 3.1.1, scikit-learn 1.9.1, mlxtend 0.25.0).

## Caveats the report must mention

- Guest/anonymous sales (24.9% of lines, 13.6% of gross revenue) are excluded from customer analytics; the clean base therefore describes registered customers, not total demand.
- The dataset ends 2011-12-09, so the T2 label window (Sep-Nov 2011) precedes the Christmas peak; churn rates are period-specific.
- Clustering is descriptive and fitted on T2 (in-sample assignment); it is not a predictive model.
- ROI uses a churn-conditional model (base: save rate 10%, contact cost GBP 8.00, margin 35%) and the model's out-of-time precision (0.669) as the expected churn rate of the targeted group. The dataset has no campaign history, so this is a scenario analysis, not measured uplift. The headline uses the model's risk-ranked precision; inside the value-weighted priority list the realised churn rate is lower (0.310), so a validated variant gives net GBP 14,803 (ROI 925%) - the headline is best read as an optimistic bound.
- Association rules are evaluated on a later holdout period, but high-lift rules are often product variants of the same item (e.g. same design, different colour), so lift overstates incremental cross-sell.
- The selected feature set drops recency_days (RFE with logistic regression) even though recency is univariately important; it is partly captured by distinct_months/avg_gap_days. Models were selected on validation PR-AUC only.
